senses.title: Making stronger
senses.titleCN: 加强：使原有力量或效果更强
senses.definition: the act of making something stronger or more effective
senses.definitionCN: 使某事物更强或更有效的行动
senses.example: The evidence was a reinforcement of the earlier claim.
senses.exampleCN: 这些证据加强了先前的说法。
senses.why: The noun is re- 'again' + in- 'in' + fortis 'strong' + -ment: literally a making strong again from within.
senses.whyCN: 该名词由 re-「再次」、in-「向内」、fortis「强」与 -ment 构成，字面是「再从内部使强」。

senses.title: Military reinforcement
senses.titleCN: 军事增援：增派兵力或装备
senses.definition: the sending of additional troops or equipment to strengthen a force
senses.definitionCN: 增派部队或装备以加强某支力量
senses.example: Reinforcements arrived before the second assault.
senses.exampleCN: 增援在第二次进攻前抵达。
senses.why: The oldest concrete sense is military: a force is made strong again by adding fresh units.
senses.whyCN: 最早的具体义项是军事：通过加入新生力量，让一支部队重新变强。

senses.title: Positive reinforcement
senses.titleCN: 正向强化：以奖励提高行为频率
senses.definition: in behavioural psychology, the delivery of a reward that increases the likelihood of a behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 行为心理学中给予奖励、从而提高某行为出现概率的做法
senses.example: Positive reinforcement made the pupils keep raising their hands.
senses.exampleCN: 正向强化让学生们持续举手。
senses.why: Behaviourism borrowed the strengthening image: a stimulus follows a behaviour and makes that behaviour more likely to recur.
senses.whyCN: 行为主义借用了「加强」意象：刺激跟在行为之后，使该行为更可能再次出现。

senses.title: Negative reinforcement
senses.titleCN: 负向强化：撤走厌恶刺激来提高行为频率
senses.definition: in behavioural psychology, the removal of an unpleasant stimulus that increases the likelihood of a behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 行为心理学中撤走不愉快刺激、从而提高某行为出现概率的做法
senses.example: Turning off the loud alarm after the correct move was negative reinforcement.
senses.exampleCN: 正确操作后关掉刺耳警报属于负向强化。
senses.why: The label is about removal, not punishment: taking away something unpleasant strengthens the behaviour that made it stop.
senses.whyCN: 这个标签讲的是「撤走」而非惩罚：去掉不快之物，强化了使其中止的行为。

senses.title: Structural reinforcement
senses.titleCN: 结构加固：给建筑补入承载构件
senses.definition: the addition of steel, fibre or other material to make a structure carry more load
senses.definitionCN: 加入钢材、纤维或其他材料，使结构承受更大荷载
senses.example: Steel reinforcement runs through the concrete floor slab.
senses.exampleCN: 钢筋混凝土楼板中布有钢筋。
senses.why: Engineering uses the same logic physically: extra material is put inside so the whole can bear more force.
senses.whyCN: 工程在物理层面沿用同一逻辑：把额外材料放进内部，使整体承受更大力量。

senses.title: Reinforcement learning
senses.titleCN: 强化学习：靠奖励信号调整策略
senses.definition: in machine learning, a method in which an agent improves its decisions from rewards and penalties
senses.definitionCN: 机器学习中智能体依据奖励与惩罚改进决策的方法
senses.example: Reinforcement learning trained the robot to walk on rough ground.
senses.exampleCN: 强化学习训练机器人在地面不平处行走。
senses.why: The algorithm receives a score after each action, so successful actions are reinforced in the policy.
senses.whyCN: 算法在每次行动后得到评分，因此成功的行动在策略中被强化。

senses.title: Social reinforcement
senses.titleCN: 社会性强化：靠赞许与关注维持行为
senses.definition: the strengthening of behaviour through approval, attention or status from other people
senses.definitionCN: 通过他人的赞许、关注或地位来加强行为
senses.example: A nod from the group is powerful social reinforcement.
senses.exampleCN: 群体的一次点头就是有力的社会性强化。
senses.why: Humans add a social layer to the reward model: approval itself can act as the reward.
senses.whyCN: 人类在奖励模型上加了社会一层：赞许本身就能充当奖励。

senses.title: Reinforcing a lesson
senses.titleCN: 巩固：重复与补充使知识更牢
senses.definition: the act of repeating or adding material so that learning or an argument is better retained
senses.definitionCN: 通过重复或补充材料，使学习或论证更牢固的行为
senses.example: The homework is reinforcement of the morning's lesson.
senses.exampleCN: 这份作业是对上午课程的巩固。
senses.why: Education borrows the strengthening metaphor: practice makes a skill hold, as if a wall were buttressed.
senses.whyCN: 教育借用了「加固」隐喻：练习让技能站得住，仿佛给墙加了扶壁。

intro.en: Reinforcement comes from reinforce, which entered English through French renforcer, from re- 'again' and enforcer 'to strengthen', ultimately from Latin fortis 'strong'.
intro.cn: reinforcement 出自 reinforce，后者经法语 renforcer 进入英语，由 re-「再次」与 enforcer「使强」构成，最终源于拉丁 fortis「强壮的」。

items.en: Fortis meant 'strong, powerful'. Its descendants include fort, fortress, effort, comfort and reinforce.
items.cn: fortis 意为「强壮的、有力的」，其后代包括 fort、fortress、effort、comfort、reinforce。

items.en: Old French renforcer meant 'to strengthen, make firm'. The prefix re- has an intensive force here, 'thoroughly', rather than simply 'again'.
items.cn: 古法语 renforcer 意为「加强、使坚固」。此处前缀 re- 带加强语气，意为「彻底」，而不只是「再次」。

items.en: English reinforce appears in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, first in military and structural contexts.
items.cn: 英语 reinforce 于 14 至 15 世纪出现，最早用于军事与结构语境。

items.en: Reinforcement adds -ment, the noun suffix from Latin -mentum, naming the act or the added material.
items.cn: reinforcement 加 -ment，即出自拉丁 -mentum 的名词后缀，命名动作或所加材料。

items.en: Twentieth-century behaviourism gave the word its learning sense: a consequence that strengthens a response.
items.cn: 20 世纪行为主义赋予该词学习义：强化某一反应的结果。

items.en: The exact first English date is uncertain, and the relative weight of the French re- as 'again' or as an intensifier is debated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（前缀语义与首见年代）：英语首见确切年代存疑；法语 re- 究竟表「再次」还是加强语气，仍有争论。

note.en: The first group separates the reinforce family; the second gives near-synonyms for strengthening and for reward.
note.cn: 第一组区分 reinforce 词族；第二组给出关于加强和奖励的近义词。

entries.definition: To make stronger or send more support. Reinforcement is the act or the added support.
entries.definitionCN: 指使更强或增派支援；reinforcement 是动作或所加支援。

entries.definition: Describing material or a structure that has been strengthened, such as reinforced concrete.
entries.definitionCN: 形容被加强的材料或结构，如钢筋混凝土。

entries.definition: In psychology, the reward itself; in construction, the strengthening element. It is the thing, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 心理学中指奖励物本身；建筑中指加固件。它是物，不是过程。

entries.definition: Physical power or a body of troops. It lacks the prefix that marks added strength.
entries.definitionCN: 指物理力量或一支部队；缺少表示「额外加强」的前缀。

entries.definition: Any process that makes something stronger. Reinforcement often implies adding something from outside or inside.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指使某物更强的过程；reinforcement 常暗示从外部或内部添加某物。

entries.definition: Bearing weight or giving help. It may be passive, while reinforcement actively adds strength.
entries.definitionCN: 指承重或给予帮助，可以是被动的；reinforcement 则主动增加强度。

entries.definition: Something given for behaviour. In psychology it is the content of positive reinforcement.
entries.definitionCN: 指为某行为给予的东西；心理学中它是正向强化的内容。

entries.definition: Combining parts into a firm whole. It stresses unity, while reinforcement stresses added strength.
entries.definitionCN: 指把部分合成坚固整体，强调统一；reinforcement 强调增加强度。

entries.definition: Extra people or resources held ready. It overlaps military reinforcement but suggests a reserve role.
entries.definitionCN: 指备用的额外人员或资源；与军事增援重叠，但暗示预备角色。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- + in- + fortis 'strong' + -ment: strength put back inside.
normal.cn: re- + in- + fortis「强」+ -ment：把强度重新放进内部。

normal.en: The family runs reinforce, reinforced, reinforcer, fort, fortress, effort.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 reinforce、reinforced、reinforcer、fort、fortress、effort。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: positive reinforcement, steel reinforcement, military reinforcement, reinforcement learning.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：正向强化、钢筋加固、军事增援、强化学习。

normal.en: Negative reinforcement removes something unpleasant; punishment adds something unpleasant.
normal.cn: 负向强化撤走不快之物；惩罚则加入不快之物。

normal.en: In concrete, steel reinforcement sits inside the slab and carries tension.
normal.cn: 混凝土中，钢筋位于板内并承受拉力。

abstract.en: Picture a wall leaning outward until a diagonal brace is bolted to its face.
abstract.cn: 想象一堵墙向外倾斜，直到一条斜撑被栓到墙面上。

abstract.en: Picture a star sticker placed on a chart each time a hand goes up.
abstract.cn: 想象每次举手都在图表上贴一颗星。

abstract.en: Picture a player receiving a score after each move and slowly favouring the winning move.
abstract.cn: 想象棋手每走一步都得到评分，慢慢偏爱制胜的那一步。

examples.en: The bridge needed reinforcement after the earthquake.
examples.cn: 地震之后，这座桥需要加固。

examples.en: The teacher used praise as positive reinforcement, not as a bribe.
examples.cn: 老师把表扬当作正向强化，而不是贿赂。

examples.en: The agent learned the maze through reinforcement learning.
examples.cn: 智能体通过强化学习学会了走迷宫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ in（进）+ force（力量）」——再往里面加力 → reinforcement 加强、强化

root: 拉丁 fortis「强壮的」→ 古法语 renforcer「加强」→ 英语 reinforce + -ment。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses add strength in different materials: a claim, an army, a behaviour, a habit, a slab, an algorithm, a social group, and a lesson.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项在不同对象上增加强度：主张、军队、行为、习惯、楼板、算法、群体与课程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a diagonal brace bolted to a leaning wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：斜撑被栓到倾斜的墙面上。

branches.en: MORE STRENGTH: an argument or an army is made stronger by addition.
branches.cn: 更强：主张或军队靠添加而变强。

branches.en: BEHAVIOUR: a reward increases a response, or the removal of something unpleasant does.
branches.cn: 行为：奖励提高反应概率，撤走不快之物也能如此。

branches.en: STRUCTURE: steel inside concrete carries the load.
branches.cn: 结构：混凝土中的钢筋承担荷载。

branches.en: MACHINE LEARNING: scores after actions reshape the policy.
branches.cn: 机器学习：行动后的评分重塑策略。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND LESSONS: approval from others, and practice, hold behaviour in place.
branches.cn: 人与课程：他人的赞许与练习把行为固定住。

intro.en: Reinforcement combines a French-derived verb of strengthening with the Latin noun suffix -ment; the base fortis also yields fort and fortress.
intro.cn: reinforcement 把法语来源的「加强」动词与拉丁名词后缀 -ment 结合；词基 fortis 还衍生出 fort 与 fortress。

latinIntro.en: The fortis family includes fort, fortress, effort, comfort, reinforce and fortitude; all centre on strength, either physical or moral.
latinIntro.cn: fortis 词族包括 fort、fortress、effort、comfort、reinforce、fortitude，核心都是力量，或物理或道德。

items.meaning: the act of strengthening; added support
items.example: The wall needs reinforcement before winter.
items.exampleCN: 这堵墙入冬前需要加固。

items.meaning: to make stronger or add support
items.example: The results reinforce our earlier finding.
items.exampleCN: 这些结果强化了我们此前的发现。

items.example: Reinforced concrete resists bending.
items.exampleCN: 钢筋混凝土抗弯。

items.meaning: the reward or material that strengthens
items.meaningCN: 起强化作用的奖励或材料
items.example: Praise can act as a reinforcer.
items.exampleCN: 表扬可以充当强化物。

items.example: The fort guarded the harbour.
items.exampleCN: 堡垒守卫着港口。

items.example: The fortress withstood the siege.
items.exampleCN: 堡垒抵挡住了围攻。

items.example: The climb took great effort.
items.exampleCN: 这次攀登花了很大力气。

items.example: Her letter brought comfort.
items.exampleCN: 她的信带来了安慰。

latinEntries.meaning: suffix forming nouns of act or result
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成动作或结果名词的后缀

definition_zh: 可靠性；可信度；可靠程度
definition_en: the quality of being dependable, or the degree to which a measurement, source or system performs consistently
core_image: 同一把尺子反复测量同一块板，刻度每次都落在同一位置
scene: The reliability of the sensor was tested by repeating the same measurement fifty times.
sceneCN: 这里 reliability 指「测量的可靠性」（第 2 个义项：重复测量结果的一致程度）；句意：传感器的可靠性通过重复同一测量五十次来检验。图中可辨识物件：传感器、重复测量曲线、刻度尺、记录表。

pos.zh: 可靠性；可信度；可靠程度（多作不可数，指不同方面时可用复数 reliabilities）

senses.title: Dependability of a person
senses.titleCN: 人的可靠：可以指望其说到做到
senses.definition: the quality of a person who can be trusted to do what is promised
senses.definitionCN: 一个人可以被信任履行承诺的品质
senses.example: Her reliability made her the obvious choice to hold the keys.
senses.exampleCN: 她的可靠使她成为保管钥匙的当然人选。
senses.why: The noun is reliable + -ity; reliable comes from rely, which originally meant 'to bind together', so reliability is the quality of being bound to one's word.
senses.whyCN: 该名词是 reliable 加 -ity；reliable 出自 rely，后者原意为「绑在一起」，因此 reliability 是「被绑定于自己承诺」的品质。

senses.title: Consistency of measurement
senses.titleCN: 测量的可靠性：重复得到相同结果
senses.definition: in research, the extent to which repeated measurements give the same result
senses.definitionCN: 研究中重复测量给出相同结果的程度
senses.example: The reliability of the sensor was tested fifty times.
senses.exampleCN: 传感器的可靠性被检验了五十次。
senses.why: Measurement theory separatedaccuracy from stability: a reading may be stable and still wrong, so reliability names only the stability.
senses.whyCN: 测量理论把准确与稳定分开：读数可以稳定却仍然错误，因此 reliability 只命名稳定性。

senses.title: Engineering reliability
senses.titleCN: 工程可靠性：设备在规定条件下不出故障
senses.definition: in engineering, the probability that a component or system performs its function without failure for a stated period
senses.definitionCN: 工程中部件或系统在规定时间内无故障执行功能的概率
senses.example: Engine reliability improved after the redesign of the cooling system.
senses.exampleCN: 冷却系统重新设计后，发动机可靠性提高了。
senses.why: Engineering made the word quantitative: failure rates and test hours turn dependability into a number.
senses.whyCN: 工程学把这个词量化：故障率与测试时长把「可依赖」变成一个数字。

senses.title: Credibility of a source
senses.titleCN: 信源可信：信息可被采信的程度
senses.definition: the degree to which a source of information can be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 信息来源可以被信任的程度
senses.example: The reliability of the witness was questioned in court.
senses.exampleCN: 证人的可信度在法庭上受到质疑。
senses.why: Here the instrument is a person's account: courts ask whether the report can be depended on, not whether a device repeats a reading.
senses.whyCN: 这里的仪器是一个人的陈述：法院追问这份报告能否被依赖，而不是装置能否重复读数。

senses.title: Inter-rater reliability
senses.titleCN: 评分者间信度：不同评分者结果一致
senses.definition: in assessment, the degree to which different raters give consistent scores
senses.definitionCN: 评估中不同评分者给出一致分数的程度
senses.example: Inter-rater reliability was high after the rubric was clarified.
senses.exampleCN: 评分标准明确后，评分者间信度很高。
senses.why: When judgement replaces a machine, consistency must be checked between people, and the word is applied to that agreement.
senses.whyCN: 当判断取代机器时，必须检查人与人之间的一致性，该词就被用于这种一致程度。

senses.title: Statistical reliability
senses.titleCN: 统计信度：结果可重复出现
senses.definition: in statistics, the consistency of a measure across samples or the repeatability of a finding
senses.definitionCN: 统计学中测量跨样本的一致性，或发现的可重复性
senses.example: The effect's reliability fell when the sample was split.
senses.exampleCN: 样本拆分后，该效应的可靠性下降了。
senses.why: Statistics asks whether the same result survives a new sample; if it does not, the measurement was stable only within one data set.
senses.whyCN: 统计学追问同一结果能否在新样本中存活；若不能，该测量的稳定只限于原数据集。

senses.title: System reliability
senses.titleCN: 系统可靠性：整体在压力下持续供电或运行
senses.definition: the ability of a whole system, such as a power grid, to keep operating under expected stress
senses.definitionCN: 整个系统（如电网）在预期压力下持续运行的能力
senses.example: Grid reliability depends on spare capacity and quick repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 电网可靠性取决于备用容量与快速修复。
senses.why: A grid is a chain of components, so the whole can fail where any link fails; system reliability counts the weakest link and the capacity held in reserve.
senses.whyCN: 电网是由部件连成的链条，任一环失效整体就可能失效；系统可靠性要计及最弱环节与储备容量。

senses.title: Reliability of memory
senses.titleCN: 记忆可靠性：回忆能否经得起核对
senses.definition: in psychology and law, the degree to which a memory or identification can be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 心理学与法律中，记忆或辨认可被信任的程度
senses.example: Eyewitness reliability decreases under stress.
senses.exampleCN: 压力之下，目击者记忆的可靠性会下降。
senses.why: The word moves inward: the measuring instrument is now a mind, and the question is whether its readings hold.
senses.whyCN: 词义向内移动：测量仪器现在是心智，问题变成它的读数是否站得住。

intro.en: Reliability is reliable plus -ity. Reliable comes from rely, which entered English through Old French relier, from Latin religare 'to bind fast' — the same root as religion, though the meanings divided.
intro.cn: reliability 是 reliable 加 -ity。reliable 出自 rely，后者经古法语 relier 进入英语，源于拉丁 religare「牢牢绑住」——与 religion 同根，但词义后来分道。

items.en: Ligare meant 'to bind, tie'. Its compounds include oblige, ligature, ally and religion, all built on binding.
items.cn: ligare 意为「绑、系」，其复合词包括 oblige、ligature、ally、religion，都建立在「绑定」意象上。

items.en: Religare strengthened ligare with re-, meaning 'to bind fast or back'. It could describe tying something securely or binding a person by obligation.
items.cn: religare 用 re- 加强 ligare，意为「牢牢绑住或绑回」，可指把某物系紧，或以义务约束某人。

items.en: Old French relier meant 'to bind, attach, depend on'. English rely first meant 'to gather together' and then 'to depend with confidence'.
items.cn: 古法语 relier 意为「绑、连接、依赖」。英语 rely 最初意为「聚拢」，后指「有把握地依赖」。

items.en: Reliable appeared in the seventeenth century, meaning 'that may be depended on'. The -able suffix marks capacity or fitness.
items.cn: reliable 于 17 世纪出现，意为「可被依赖的」；-able 后缀标记能力或适合性。

items.en: Reliability followed as the abstract noun, and twentieth-century statistics and engineering made it a measured property.
items.cn: reliability 随后作为抽象名词出现；20 世纪的统计学与工程学把它变成可测量的属性。

items.en: The exact first English citation is uncertain, and the semantic split between rely and religion is a later development rather than part of the original root meaning.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代）：英语最早书证确切年代存疑；rely 与 religion 的语义分化属于后来的发展，并非原始词根义的一部分。

note.en: The first group separates the rely family; the second gives near-synonyms for trustworthiness and consistency.
note.cn: 第一组区分 rely 词族；第二组给出关于可信与一致的近义词。

entries.definition: Describing someone or something that can be depended on; reliability is the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 形容可以依赖的人或物；reliability 是对应名词。

entries.definition: To depend on someone or something. It names the act of trusting, not the quality.
entries.definitionCN: 指依赖某人或某物；命名信任的行为，而非性质。

entries.definition: The condition of depending on something. It is the dependence, not the trustworthiness of the object.
entries.definitionCN: 指依赖的状态；是依赖本身，而非对象的可信程度。

entries.definition: From Latin religio, traditionally linked to religare 'bind fast'. It shares the root with rely but has followed a separate semantic path.
entries.definitionCN: 出自拉丁 religio，传统上与 religare「牢牢绑住」相关。它与 rely 同根，但走上了独立的语义路径。

entries.definition: The quality of being worthy of trust. It is close to sense 1 but more personal and moral.
entries.definitionCN: 指值得信任的品质；接近第 1 个义项，但更偏人格与道德。

entries.definition: The quality of being dependable in practice. It overlaps sense 1 but stresses performance over time.
entries.definitionCN: 指在实践中可被指望的品质；与第 1 个义项重叠，但强调长期表现。

entries.definition: The quality of giving the same results or behaving the same way. It is the core of measurement reliability.
entries.definitionCN: 指给出相同结果或行为一致的性质，是测量可靠性的核心。

entries.definition: In research, the degree to which a test measures what it claims to measure. Reliability is stability; validity is correctness of target.
entries.definitionCN: 研究中指测试测量其所声称之物的程度。reliability 是稳定，validity 是目标正确。

entries.definition: The quality of being believed. It concerns acceptance by an audience more than technical consistency.
entries.definitionCN: 指可被相信的品质，更关乎受众的接受，而非技术一致性。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: rely 'bind fast' + -able + -ity: the quality of being tied to one's word.
normal.cn: rely「牢牢绑住」+ -able + -ity：被绑定于承诺的品质。

normal.en: The family runs rely, reliable, reliably, reliance, unreliable.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 rely、reliable、reliably、reliance、unreliable。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: test reliability, inter-rater reliability, system reliability, reliability engineering.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：考试信度、评分者间信度、系统可靠性、可靠性工程。

normal.en: Reliability is stability; validity is measuring the right thing.
normal.cn: reliability 是稳定性；validity 是测对了东西。

normal.en: religion and rely share the root 'bind', but their meanings divided long ago.
normal.cn: religion 与 rely 共享「绑定」词根，但词义早已分化。

abstract.en: Picture the same ruler laid on the same board fifty times, each mark landing identically.
abstract.cn: 想象同一把尺子在同一块板上量五十次，每次刻度都落在同一处。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge cable that holds the same load year after year without slackening.
abstract.cn: 想象桥梁缆索年复一年承受同一荷载，从未松脱。

abstract.en: Picture two examiners scoring the same essay and arriving at the same number.
abstract.cn: 想象两位阅卷人给同一篇作文打分，得到相同数字。

examples.en: The reliability of the test was checked by repeating it with the same group.
examples.cn: 该测试的可靠性通过在同一组人身上重复测试来检验。

examples.en: Reliability engineering studies how often parts fail and why.
examples.cn: 可靠性工程研究部件多常失效以及原因。

examples.en: The court weighed the reliability of the identification against the lighting conditions.
examples.cn: 法院结合照明条件权衡了辨认结果的可靠性。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rely（依赖）+ ability（能力）」——值得依赖的能力 → reliability 可靠性

root: 拉丁 ligare「绑」→ religare「牢牢绑住」→ 古法语 relier → 英语 rely；加 -able 与 -ity 成 reliability。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses test the same question in different instruments: a person's word, a sensor, an engine, a witness, a rubric, a statistic, a grid, a memory.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项在不同的「仪器」上检验同一个问题：人的承诺、传感器、发动机、证人、评分标准、统计结果、电网、记忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one ruler laid on one board fifty times, every mark aligned.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一把尺在同一块板上量五十次，每次刻度对齐。

branches.en: A PERSON: the promise is the thing that holds.
branches.cn: 人：被绑定的是承诺。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: repeated readings and split samples test stability.
branches.cn: 测量：重复读数与拆分样本检验稳定性。

branches.en: MACHINES: components and whole grids are counted by failure and uptime.
branches.cn: 机器：部件与整个电网按故障与运行时间计量。

branches.en: JUDGEMENT: witnesses and raters are checked against one another.
branches.cn: 判断：证人与评分者被相互核对。

branches.en: MEMORY: the inward instrument may give a stable but wrong reading.
branches.cn: 记忆：内在仪器可能给出稳定却错误的读数。

intro.en: Reliability is an adjective of trust turned into a quality noun: rely, reliable, then -ity, with the root ligare 'bind' underneath.
intro.cn: reliability 是表示信任的形容词转为性质名词：rely、reliable，再加 -ity，底层词根是 ligare「绑」。

latinIntro.en: The ligare family includes rely, reliable, religion, oblige, ligature, ally and league; the shared image is something tied or bound.
latinIntro.cn: ligare 词族包括 rely、reliable、religion、oblige、ligature、ally、league，共同意象是被系住或绑住之物。

items.example: The reliability of the data was questioned.
items.exampleCN: 这些数据的可靠性受到质疑。

items.example: She is a reliable witness.
items.exampleCN: 她是一位可靠的证人。

items.example: We rely on the backup generator.
items.exampleCN: 我们依赖备用发电机。

items.meaning: the state of depending on something
items.example: Reliance on one supplier is risky.
items.exampleCN: 依赖单一供应商有风险。

items.meaning: a system of faith and worship
items.example: The region has two major religions.
items.exampleCN: 该地区有两大宗教。

items.meaning: to bind by duty or favour
items.example: The law obliges firms to report.
items.exampleCN: 法律要求公司报告。

items.example: The surgeon used a ligature to close the vessel.
items.exampleCN: 外科医生用结扎带闭合血管。

items.example: The two parties allied against the threat.
items.exampleCN: 两方结盟应对威胁。
